claim_audit_results.claim_summary: Four work packages (WP1/WP3/WP4/WP5) with stated titles and leads.
Single-researcher action; fellow executes all WP science, partners in kind.
Eleven deliverables with canonical titles and due months (M3/M14/M18/M24/M30).
Six milestones MS1/MS6/MS2/MS3/MS4/MS5 with verifiable criteria; MS6 freezes model pre-field.
Inter-WP dependencies: strict WP4->WP5 (T4.3->T5.1); WP1->WP3/WP4, WP3->WP4 non-strict data_input.
Critical path T2.3->T3.5->T4.3->T5.1->MS5.
WP4 uses AgroVIR consultation and incremental development from M1.
30-month action: 24-month EF at host plus 6-month placement under CC-07.
Single-beneficiary European Fellowship; mobility element is WP5 placement; no secondments.
Host and sole beneficiary is HUN-REN Agrartudomanyi Kutatokozpont (PIC 866599553, Martonvasar).
Fellow is Dr. Rositsa Cholakova.
Primary supervisor Prof. Tibor Janda heads the Plant Physiology and Metabolomics Department.
Fellow 30 PM split WP1 9.0, WP3 6.6, WP4 6.0, WP5 5.4, cross-cutting 3.0.
Grouped ten-row risk register R01-R10 with L/I ratings and mitigations.
Risk philosophy treats transfer loss as a scientific result to be quantified, not concealed.
R04 site-contingency ladder: written access, Farmer 2 (claim-preserving), then Skanzen (downgraded).
Project Steering Group issues go/no-go verdicts at milestones MS1-MS5.
Host previously hosted MSCA-IF LANDRACES (H2020 752453) and holds current HE participations.
Host provides computational/data environment, phenotyping, HUN-REN infrastructure and drought-physiology dept.
Single-beneficiary action; ELTE, MATE, Krumatic are associated partners plus placement host and validation site.
Co-supervisor Prof. Andras Jung, Professor at ELTE Institute of Cartography and Geoinformatics.
ELTE provides GIS/RS lab, DJI Matrice 350 RTK with L1/P1/H20T, Ultris S5, Cubert CUVIS, HPC, UAV support.
MATE (PIC 891269563) supplies the 2022-2026 tomato archive and validation instrument base.
KRUMATIK EOOD (EIK 201511899, Sofia) provides software development from M1 and Bulgarian uptake.
Placement host AGROVIR Kft., Hungarian SME founded 2007 in Budaors, operates a cloud FMIS.
AgroVIR FMIS in production across 745,000+ ha in eight countries incl. Hungary and Bulgaria.
WP5 placement work content: MVP evaluation, interoperability assessment, FMIS-integration/exploitation roadmap.
Validation site is an unnamed independent commercial farmer instrumented by the project; fellow retains science.
Szentendre Skanzen is a confirmed measurement-only contingency, not a guaranteed second experiment.
MVCRI Plovdiv retained as post-MSCA replication route, on no WP month line.
Placement provides operational evaluation against a production FMIS the academic host cannot provide alone.
